title: fix: preserve settings edits while discard waits for autosave
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes Settings losing edits entered after Discard when an earlier autosave is still pending.

## User Impact

Newer Raw edits remain available to save, and newer Form edits resume autosaving after the pending request settles.

## Why This Change Was Made

At `ui/src/lib/config/config-draft-discard.ts:19`, Discard drained the outstanding write and then replaced the draft without checking for newer editing intent. The existing write coordinator now tracks that intent, abandons a superseded discard before clearing patches, and reuses the configuration read owner's admission callback to guard the reload response. Autosave resumes when a newer edit supersedes Discard.

No parallel discard owner or recovery path was added. Production delta: +20/-6; tests: +47/-0; documentation: +1/-1.

## Evidence

The Raw and Form regressions both fail on unchanged current main: the newer value `4` is replaced by the previously submitted `2`. Both pass with the repair, including subsequently saving the retained value. All 44 focused tests pass across draft revision, write coordination, field discard, and autosave reconnect.

Focused UI lint, formatting, and `git diff --check` pass. Independent Codex review found no actionable P0–P2 findings. No live provider or Gateway was exercised, per this repair's focused proof scope.

Historical synthetic captures from original head `d5b9cfa3e23be85a1a0419dcdf30e98ff1469887`, inspected again during this repair; these are not fresh captures of the rewritten head:

Before:
![Delayed discard erases the newer Raw edit](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5e0c2502-353d-4dfa-9b7c-66514004b283)

After:
![Newer edit remains pending and can be saved](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3df8d6c8-b3de-4c10-ae6b-37ee92cd9335)

## Conflict resolution validation

Merged current main at `a57c9b539b8f438c3ea339c3d6fda73396ff41d3`. The sole conflict was `ui/src/lib/config/config-draft-revision.test.ts`: retained main shared setup and cleanup, then adapted both reviewed Raw/Form regressions to `loadedConfig`. No production logic changed beyond the already reviewed fix.

All 44 focused tests across draft revision, write coordination, field discard, and autosave reconnect passed (5.88 seconds wall). Targeted oxlint, four-file oxfmt, diff checks, and fresh isolated P0–P2 review passed. Exact-head CI 39639297373 attempt 1 failed only in the unchanged Chat initial-mount test `chat-page-pending-retention.test.ts` (the admission row expected Previous transcript) and its dependent gate. That shard did not execute the new config regression; both Chat test cases passed in a focused local replay (21.77 seconds). This is an unrelated flake; the passing replay is not a claimed repair. The single authorized failed-job retry passed: [CI run 39639297373, attempt 2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39639297373/attempts/2) completed successfully, including the aggregate gate. No admin exception was needed.
